items.name: Play Extreme Cubing B 2025

venue.name: Play Extreme Cafe
venue.address: No 3, KSS Padmavathi Ammal street, Padur, Chennai, Tamil Nadu 603103

items.information:
Please **review all of the tabs listed on this website.**

* All participants must be present for the entire duration of the competition irrespective of the number of events.

* All the participants are requested to volunteer in the competition and every participant (except newcomers) will be assigned to a particular event they have to either judge, scramble, etc for the group/event.
 
* Only one guest per participant is allowed owing to space constraints in the venue. 

* We won't be allowing late entry in the competition under any exceptions. Make sure you will be available at the venue when your name is called.

* Make sure you go through all the WCA regulations.

* If you're participating in a WCA competition for first time or unaware of competition rules, make sure that you attend the tutorial session.

* Participants must bring their own cubes.

items.name: PRs in Binondo 2025
items.information:
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTA2Nzg4LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--e0c0aa540c48dc90b9c4013e25719f9def41f9d4/IMG_6671.png)

Welcome to PRs in Binondo! 2025, the second speedcubing competition at the oldest Chinatown in the world! This competition will feature a speedcubing twist where all the rounds of a single event is held consecutively, simulating a PR worth environment. The events of this competition are 4x4, 5x5, 3x3 Blindfolded, 3x3 Multiblind, Megaminx and 4x4 Blindfolded with **4x4** as the main event.

We encourage reading through all information tabs to be properly informed of additional information and requirements needed for registration and competing.

This competition is hosted by  **Cubers and Friends**.
